name: sdd-kit
description: The skill set for our Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflow. These are the skills we actually reach for while doing SDD — capturing the decisions and lessons behind a spec, then running the Azure DevOps work a plan turns into — so it is deliberately not a general-purpose collection, and most of it has little use outside SDD. /create-decision records design decisions as Decision Records in the Memory Bank, /create-lesson-learned captures recurring patterns and pitfalls for later specs, and /ado-cli handles the Azure DevOps side of delivery via the az CLI: pipeline analysis, PR review/create/update, work item management, and changelogs (on-prem Server, PAT auth).
